comments: Registered as one bank on the plinth: the pivot x is the centre of the plinth, the bottom edge the plinth's lowest line, one shared scale. Only the pennant changes between the drawings.
geometry: Tiles, footprints and every collision are the town map's (rules/moonfall/town.rs); art never sets a hitbox.
mapping_basis: Visual review of the delivered sheet and its measured crops, 2026-10-18. Five drawings on a 3x2 grid in reading order = request order: idle-0, cry-0 .. cry-3. The crops are tight and separated.
